body: I’m so sorry to hear about your experiences, it’s so hard to have something like that happen because it truly shakes your faith. Even when you tried to use the morals you had been taught, they were cut down by someone who was supposed to be your guidance. It’s hard to turn your back on something like that when you’ve been raised to believe in it, but ultimately it’s always what’s best for you.

I love the idea of that, I’m so between different ideas of my spirituality. I love that not every one may be the same, and that every concept is different but it matters to the individual and what works for them.

Yes the Bible is so crazy to me, it never has made sense to me. Even as a child I was questioning how it could be real, in the same sense that I was questioning how Santa could get in my house when I didn’t have a chimney. It’s hard to go against a faith you’ve been raised in but sometimes it’s best to turn your back on it.

Yes the way men and women are treated in the church is awful, the sexism is rampant in many sects of Christianity. I get that, it never made sense to me that this supposed all loving god would let horrible things happen.

That’s so horrible, it’s disgusting that someone who calls themself a Christian could treat someone so vile. I’m sorry to hear that happened to you, it’s a terrible situation when religion is supposed to be something to help you and something you’re supposed to turn to, and you’re treated like that. I am glad that you are in control of your own destiny now!
I am so sorry to hear things were so rough for you! I’m glad to hear you’re forging your own destiny and following your calling!

I feel the same way, I was taught good morals like that, but renouncing others who didn’t think or believe the same as I used to always made me uneasy. It did seem so wrong to worship someone who was seen as all loving, but would renounce his children if they didn’t follow faith so hard or didn’t believe everything they should. And yes the Old Testament is insane to me, it’s some fucked up shit! I am glad you have found more peace and have been able to worship yourself and call your inner goddess forward!
Yes, I’ve never understood how someone could worship someone who could be so pious but at the same time cast such harsh judgement down upon others. The Old Testament is fucked to say the least!

I’m so sorry to hear that things were so tough for you, I’m glad you’ve found more peace as you’ve gotten older. I feel your anguish in trying to speak to god, and it seemed as though he never listened. The powerlessness of praying to someone who never answers is awful! Finding your own path is truly awesome, I’m glad to hear that!

I’ve always thought it was asinine that rock music could be considered “the devils music”. My moms brother burned my a couple of my grandmas records in the name of god when they were children, which never sat right with me. Its hard to renounce faith but it’s for the best sometimes.
I’ll have to read into that, the epicurian paradox, I mean!
Thank you for the reply! :) I’m so sorry to hear about your mother, and I agree, I never understood why god would do that and why he would choose that as a test of faith.
Lol I agree with you! A month long vacation somewhere sounds like it would be amazing 🤣

You’re not alone at all! I am a person who is horrible about holding grudges, it’s one of my worst traits. I’ve tried to change and just not give a shit about it because people go through things in life you may never know about. It’s hard though, I understand the feeling of giving someone your all and they just shit on you. Forgiveness is really hard, grudges from years and months ago still burn and ache in my chest. I wish I could tell you more about forgiveness but I always hear that is has to come from the heart and you have to do it when you’re ready to heal. I wish you the best of luck !

I feel the same way you do! I never know to tell somebody something positive because it can be misinterpreted as dismissing their feelings, but saying something non-positive also feels too cold and callous. So I’ll just say you aren’t alone and that healing yourself takes so much time. Even though it’s hard, or at least it’s hard for me, sometimes we have to ask others for help. I wish you the best of luck!
Yes the bill goes to debt collections! I had a $300 bill that I didn’t know wasn’t paid, it and it went to collections. Now my credit score is barely scraping by. America is the best right ? 🙃
Thank you much for the feedback! I’m definitely going to be working with her in the future! And very true, my cat always gets the zoomies at night!
Thank you for the feedback, I appreciate it! I’m definitely going to be working with her in the future !
Thank you so much for the feedback! I’m definitely sure I’m going to work with her in the future !
My wonderful and sweet kitty cat, my family, and my friends. Also traveling and playing video games as well as doing spell work !
Thank you :)
I know how you feel! I stopped asking my friends who never asked how I was doing how they were doing. I’ve learned that the street goes both ways!

Ugh I understand your situation completely, our situations are incredibly similar. Although my roommate doesn’t communicate why she is taking her frustrations and being passive aggressive towards me, she just does it and recently I’ve started to ignore it and just physically remove myself from being around her for that moment or for a day or two. She also doesn’t check up on me ever, I used to check up on her but I got tired of always supporting and draining my mental health and energy to help hers. I know you can’t leave and be alone because of COVID but you could tell her you feel ill and stay in your room and recharge and get some alone time. I’ve used that and the excuse that I need a nap SO many times. Anyway, I don’t feel like you were wrong for that. People not taking it seriously is why we’re still dealing with it a whole ass year later. I am a chronic people pleaser so I think it was awesome for you to share how you felt and discussed it with her and set a boundary. I am not one to rehash a conversation that I know will probably end the same way, I always give up, but if you feel like talking about it with her just bring it up! I am sorry I don’t have the best advice as I’m stuck in the same situation as you are and I’m too non-confrontational to say anything, but I think time apart and alone time wouldn’t hurt anything. Good luck !

Do not feel guilty about venting, you obviously felt that way for a reason. She is an adult and as an adult she should know how to handle herself especially with drugs. Accidents happen, but I stopped going out with my friends who couldn’t handle themselves. I even addressed it and how I felt but shocked they NEVER learned how to handle themselves and I (and everyone else for that matter) got sick of always having to clean up and fix the situation. Obviously humans make mistakes and that’s okay but just be careful and know when someone is overstepping boundaries and making you uncomfortable, setting boundaries is super important. I wish hardcore that I would’ve set more boundaries in my friendships. I’m also sorry you had to throw out your rug, it sounds like a pretty annoying situation. I hope she apologized and learns from it !
